title: My utility functions
text: update_github() – update locally installed GitHub packages save_installed_pkgs() – save names installed (non-base) packages file, upgrading R restore_installed_pkgs() – reinstall packages file saved save_installed_pkgs(), upgrading R update_pkgs() – update installed CRAN + Bioconductor packages one non-interactive run, logging lock-retry handling; meant run background (e.g. Rscript -e "myutil::update_pkgs()") rather RStudio’s (blocking) package updater

title: My utility functions
text: set composable steps CRAN release process, meant run root package released (myutil). Run individually, via release_run_all(). release_preflight() – cross-check DESCRIPTION Version/Date NEWS.md CRAN release_document() – rebuild documentation (devtools::document()) release_spelling() / release_spelling_add() – spell-check, selectively add accepted words inst/WORDLIST release_urls() – check documentation URLs release_site() – rebuild README pkgdown site release_build() – build tarball, vignettes, manual release_check() – run R CMD check ---cran locally release_check_win() – check win-builder (R-devel) release_revdep() – check reverse dependencies release_cran_comments() – regenerate cran-comments.md results steps release_run_all() – run automatable steps sequence, collecting failures instead stopping first one

title: My utility functions
text: man() – open package’s PDF manual (CRAN, built locally) use_data_doc() – generate roxygen documentation shell dataset sourceDir() – source R files directory, e.g. try -progress package changes without reinstalling Rpackages.bib() – write BibTeX file citations installed packages, R project’s dependencies (via renv::dependencies()), attached packages

title: myutil 1.9.0
text: First version NEWS Added reset_par() (2026-09-01: defined without @export/docs since first added, never actually usable myutil::reset_par(); now exported documented) Added use_data_doc() Added save_installed_pkgs() restore_installed_pkgs(), saving/reinstalling set installed packages across R version upgrade Added CRAN release-check workflow, portable across packages: release_preflight(), release_document(), release_spelling(), release_spelling_add(), release_urls(), release_site(), release_build(), release_check(), release_check_win(), release_revdep(), release_cran_comments(), release_run_all() Enabled markdown roxygen (Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)) Reorganized README.md categories Added update_pkgs(), non-interactive CRAN + Bioconductor package updates logging self-locked-DLL retry handling Added Rpackages.bib(), maintaining master BibTeX file R package citations. Dropped old per-entry CRAN-DOI-stamping step – citation() already supplies correct DOI (none) per entry R 4.x, old step clobbered legitimate non-CRAN DOIs Book/Article-type citations (e.g. citation("sf"))
